findings.title: All env access goes through ConfigService
findings.message: Direct access to process.env.SKIP_REDIS_PROBE detected on line 90. All environment variable access must go through ConfigService. The value should be read from a typed ConfigService property instead of directly from process.env.

claims.claim: Direct access to process.env.SKIP_REDIS_PROBE is detected on line 90 of apps/api/src/infrastructure/queue/queue.module.ts
claims.reason: The diff shows line 90 contains: `const skip = parseSkipRedisProbe(process.env.SKIP_REDIS_PROBE, false);` This is a direct access to process.env.SKIP_REDIS_PROBE.

claims.claim: All environment variable access must go through ConfigService
claims.reason: The rule document explicitly states: 'Feature code must never read process.env directly. Add a typed property + validator on ConfigService and inject ConfigService where you need the value.' This is the core requirement of the rule.

claims.claim: The value should be read from a typed ConfigService property instead of directly from process.env
claims.reason: The rule document demonstrates the correct pattern: inject ConfigService and access typed properties (e.g., `this.config.sendgridKey`). The rule explicitly states to 'Add a typed property + validator on ConfigService and inject ConfigService where you need the value.' The code at line 90 violates this by reading directly from process.env instead of using a ConfigService property.
